assessments.finding_note: “郭淮只得分兵守雍、郿”将守军部署概括得不准确：原文是张郃守长安、孙礼守雍城、郭淮亲自守郿城，并非郭淮分兵驻守两处。
assessments.reason: The accepted scene misattributes the defense of Yong and Mei to Guo Huai and omits the distinct assignments of Zhang He to Chang'an and Sun Li to Yongcheng, changing the actors and military deployment.
assessments.required_fix: 改为：张郃守长安，孙礼守雍城，郭淮亲自守郿城，并向朝廷告急。
